snippet.title: Method of Entry | Official Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Method of Entry is a slow-paced 5v5 tactical shooter built on the C.F.R.F. (Competitive First, Realism Follows) philosophy. No flashy hero abilities and no arcade killstreaks just grounded CQB combat where raw skill and team strategy dictate success.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2493050/Method_Of_Entry/
💬 Join the Official Discord: https://discord.gg/methodofentry

5v5 Bomb Defusal: Intricate maps requiring coordinated breaches and site holds.

The 'Lights Out' Mechanic: Our signature intel-denial system. A non-headshot kill provides a narrow window of fading vision and audio, allowing you to hear footsteps or gunshots as you collapse. A headshot is 'Lights Out' an instant black screen and total silence. The sensory feed is severed the millisecond the bullet connects. Dead operators don't give live callouts.

Specialised Roles & Round-Based Economy: Teams consist of Rifleman, Pointman, Marksman, and Tactician. Loadouts are restricted by role. Crucially, the economy is isolated per round,
meaning one bad loss doesn't ruin your team's purchasing power for the rest of the half.

The Arsenal: 10 firearms across five categories, one for each faction: Pistols, Shotguns, SMGs, Assault Rifles, and DMRs. 

Tactical Utility (No Frag-Spam): We removed lethal frag grenades to ensure combat remains gun-skill focused. Environmental control is driven by a diverse kit:

Entry: Breaching charges, flashbangs, stinger grenades, and deployable tactical ladders for realistic verticality.

Area Denial: Corrosive acid bottles, tear gas, and smoke.

Defensive: Shotgun booby traps and door jammers.

Developed by Attack Dog Studios, Method of Entry is built for the hardcore tactical community. We focus on a strictly PvP environment where communication is a requirement, not an option.

What's your Method?

#MethodOfEntry #TacticalFPS #CQB #HardcoreShooter #IndieGame #FPS
